scientific_integrity: Analytical containment plus positive finite John certificates establish the theorem; exact rational and numerical code are corroborative checks, not infinite computational proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers integer dimension d>=2 and cone half-aperture 0<theta<=pi/2 only; the maximizer for larger apertures or non-Euclidean balls is not asserted. A close half-cone full-text priority comparison remains unavailable; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact John ellipsoids and a sharp aperture transition for spherical sectors
